datasets.name: Ins_MotorFull
datasets.sql: select im.rowid,im.* from ins_motorfull im where im.cid=:cid

datasets.name: More_Report
datasets.sql: select id,full_id,name||'  '||surname||'  '||fathername as name,age,experience,history from INS_MOTORMORETHANONEDRIVER where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: Accesories
datasets.sql:
select im.rowid,im.* from ins_motor_accesories im

where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax,c.contactperson from ins_customers c

datasets.name: Suggestion
datasets.sql:
select  s.rowid,s.* from ins_mf_suggestion s
where mk_id = :mk_id

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.id = :cid
and type_id = 4

datasets.name: ODSAgents
datasets.sql: select a.id,a.name||' '||a.surname||' '||a.fathername as name from ins_agents a

datasets.name: MoreThanOne
datasets.sql:
select im.rowid,im.* from INS_MOTORMORETHANONEDRIVER im

where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: ODSMarks
datasets.sql:
Select * from ins_dict_marks
order by name

datasets.name: ODSModels
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_dict_models

where mark_id = :mark_id
order by name

datasets.name: ODSFranshiz
datasets.sql:
select itf.ammount as franshiz, it.ammount as tariff
  from ins_tarif_franshiz itf, ins_tariffs it
where itf.month_id = :month_id
and 
  it.franshiz_id = itf.id
order by itf.ammount

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state )

datasets.name: ODSAvalute
datasets.sql:
select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute
order by valute
